name: MAGGOTKIN OF NURGLE: GREAT UNCLEAN ONE
description: Great Unclean Ones possess the same boundless energy as a swift-spreading virus. Their booming voices roll across the battlefield, their cruel jollity and the perverse pride they take in the achievements of their underlings horribly at odds with the misery and disease they spread.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds a Great Unclean One, a greater daemon for your Death Guard or Chaos Daemons armies in games of Warhammer 40,000, or your Maggotkin of Nurgle armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. They are among the most resilient creatures in the galaxy, capable of absorbing and generously doling out the most grievous damage. The Great Unclean One can be equipped with either a rusted bilesword or a doomsday bell, and a plague flail or bileblade. They also have a choice of two different heads, making it easy to customise your diseased behemoth. The kit includes six Nurglings clutching items such as censers or just hanging about. They can be added to the miniature anywhere you like.</br></br>This kit can alternatively be built as Rotigus, a favoured greater daemon of Nurgle – capable of casting foul sorceries in addition to being just as hard to kill as a Great Unclean One.</br></br>This kit comprises 59 plastic components, and 1x Citadel 130mm Round Base. This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
